dialogue.chat/1: Oh, a proper conversation? Alright then. Go on.
dialogue.chat/2: You've got the look of someone with questions. Out with them.
dialogue.chat/3: Talk? Gladly. The fence posts never answer back.
dialogue.chat/4: Sure, I've a moment. Maybe two if it's interesting.
dialogue.chat/5: Well now. What shall we untangle today, %1$s?
dialogue.chatmode.busy.toddler/2: Not now — I'm super duper busy.
dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: Give me a moment — I'm in the middle of something.
dialogue.chatmode.busy/2: One moment, I'm busy just now.
dialogue.chatmode.busy/3: Can it wait? My hands are full.
dialogue.chatmode.clarify.toddler/2: %2$s? Or %3$s? I forgot which you said.
dialogue.chatmode.confused.toddler/1: Huh? I dunno what that means.
dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Hm? I didn't quite catch that.
dialogue.chatmode.confused/3: I'm not sure what you mean, %1$s.
dialogue.chatmode.dropped.toddler/2: Okay okay. What else, what else?
dialogue.chatmode.group.bystander_privac: Careful. That was told to you, not to the square.
Leave that one where it was put, would you.
dialogue.chatmode.group.corroborate/1: It was like that when I came past, near enough.
dialogue.chatmode.group.corroborate/2: That's right, and it was worse before they got to it.
dialogue.chatmode.group.corroborate/3: I saw the same. I'd have said it was Tuesday, though.
dialogue.chatmode.group.coworker_detail/: Take the second batch, not the first. The first is always short.
And check it before you carry it. Same trade, same trouble.
It's the same for me, only mine goes wrong in the morning instead.
dialogue.chatmode.group.family_remembers: That isn't how I remember it, and I was standing right there.
You've moved that story two years closer every time you tell it.
Ask me about that one sometime. My version is shorter.
dialogue.chatmode.group.friendly_disagre: I've never once seen the appeal, and we've argued about it for years.
That's one opinion. Mine is the other one.
You two go on. I'll be over here being wrong about it.
dialogue.chatmode.hail/2: Well met, %1$s. Good to see you about.
dialogue.chatmode.hail/3: Ah, %1$s! I was hoping I'd run into you.
dialogue.chatmode.hail/4: There's a face I don't mind seeing. Hello.
dialogue.chatmode.hail_cold.toddler/1: *peeks out from behind a fence post*
dialogue.chatmode.hail_cold.toddler/2: I'm not s'posed to talk to you.
dialogue.chatmode.hint.toddler/1: I only know little stuff... like %2$s!
dialogue.chatmode.hint.toddler/2: Um, um... you could ask about %2$s?
dialogue.chatmode.hint/2: Not sure what you're after — maybe ask about %2$s?
dialogue.chatmode.hint/3: We could talk about %2$s, if you like.
dialogue.chatmode.insult.toddler/1: That's a mean word. I'm telling!
dialogue.chatmode.kidtopic/1: I dunno 'bout that. That's grown-up talk.
dialogue.chatmode.kidtopic/2: That sounds like big-people stuff. Wanna see my mud pie instead?
dialogue.chatmode.muted.toddler/1: Okay... I'll be quiet now. Shhh.
dialogue.chatmode.muted/3: As you wish — I'll say no more.
dialogue.chatmode.shrug.toddler/2: *shrugs so hard they nearly topple over*
dialogue.chatmode.topic.ask_more: that you want to hear more
dialogue.chatmode.topics: my day, my work, the village, or how I've been
dialogue.conversations.arc.dreams.resume: So that's where it's got to.
Keep at it. You'll get there.
It might not happen, you know.
I'll let you get on with it.
That thing I told you I wanted.
What's the first step? I'll help with that.
dialogue.conversations.arc.family.resume: I'll ask how it's going next time.
I'll let you get back to it.
I'll just listen, if that's better.
I'll let you get back to it.
Tell me what would actually help.
Anyway. That's still where it is.
How did it go, in the end?
I said I'd remember. I did.
I'll let you get back to it.
dialogue.conversations.arc.fears.followt: I'll not make a thing of it.
You've come a long way with it.
You don't have to be finished.
You remember what I told you.
Look at you. That's not nothing.
I'll not make a fuss of it.
I meant what I said, back then.
dialogue.conversations.arc.fears.plan.fo: Then I'll be there for that bit.
I can't promise. But I'll try.
dialogue.conversations.arc.fears.plan.re: You don't need a plan. I'm here.
Then let's do something about it.
dialogue.conversations.arc.feelings.resu: So that's where I am with it.
Is there more of it than that?
I should be honest about where I am.
About what I said to you.
That's the state of the hoping.
I'm hoping for it too, now.
That thing I was hoping for.
dialogue.conversations.arc.life.resume.f: That explains a lot about you.
Was there more you left out?
I'm glad I know that now.
dialogue.conversations.arc.life.resume.r: You remember what I told you.
And where does that leave you now?
It was a long time ago.
dialogue.conversations.arc.neighbour.res: And that's where we leave it.
Thank you for keeping me in it.
I'll keep looking in on them.
Best they never know it was me.
dialogue.conversations.arc.news.resume.f: And that's where we leave it.
Thank you for keeping me in it.
dialogue.conversations.arc.news.resume.r: That's the end of that piece of news.
Is there anything else they need?
dialogue.conversations.arc.noticed.resum: And that's where we leave it.
Thank you for keeping me in it.
That's where I am with it.
I'll make it a regular thing.
dialogue.conversations.arc.people.resume: And that's where we leave it.
Thank you for keeping me in it.
What did you say to them?
dialogue.conversations.arc.regrets.resum: What would putting it right look like?
That thing I told you I regret.
Has it sat any easier since?
So about that thing you did.
Have you thought any more about putting it right?
dialogue.conversations.arc.rumors.resume: And that's where we leave it.
Thank you for keeping me in it.
dialogue.conversations.arc.secret.resume: That's the shape of it now.
What happens if it does get out?
That thing I trusted you with.
I've been thinking of letting it slip.
dialogue.conversations.arc.standing.resu: And that's where we leave it.
Thank you for keeping me in it.
That's the reckoning, such as it is.
dialogue.conversations.arc.us.resume.clo: That's it settled, then. For now.
Can I ask you again in a month?
For what it's worth — this mattered.
dialogue.conversations.arc.us.resume.fol: Let it rest a while longer.
One thing. Small enough to actually happen.
dialogue.conversations.arc.us.resume.res: So. Where are we with it?
Where has it got to, for you?
I meant what I said. I still do.
dialogue.conversations.arc.village.resum: And that's where we leave it.
Thank you for keeping me in it.
So it stands where it stood.
I can't, as it turns out.
dialogue.conversations.arc.work.resume.f: And that's the whole of it, for now.
I'll ask again, and I'll remember the answer.
dialogue.conversations.arc.work.resume.r: So that's where the plan stands.
You said the same thing last time.
Tell me what would move it.
Thank you. The guessing was worse than any of it turned out to be.
Fair. I'll not ask anything else today — that's enough to be going on with.
You're the only one who did. I'll remember which of you told me.
Do you mean that? People say next time and then there's a next time.
Good. Standing at the neighbours' window is the worst part of any of it.
Then I'll hold you to it, and I'll be unbearable if you forget.
dialogue.conversations.ask_parent.event/: Everyone stopped talking when I came in. That's how I knew there was something.
You all went to the thing and I stayed with the neighbours. Nobody said why.
It is. I'm not a baby. I'd rather be told the bad version than guess a worse one.
You mean it? People say things to children. You don't say things.
Then I'll do the gate next. Don't watch — I want it finished first.
I've been carrying that around all week waiting for somebody to say so.
Now? ...Alright. Don't say anything about the corner, I know about the corner.
You'll have to come out to the yard. And you'll have to not laugh.
You're the first to ask to see it. Wait there — I'll fetch it.
dialogue.conversations.ask_parent.pride/: I mended the fence myself. Nobody asked me to and nobody's noticed but you.
I can read the long words now. All of them, not only the ones on the sign.
...I didn't cry when the old dog went. I wanted to. I thought you should know.
dialogue.conversations.ask_parent.rebuff: ...Then I'll ask again tomorrow. Quieter, mind.
You'd be surprised how rarely anyone says that to me, %1$s.
Alright. But you'll answer properly next time, or I really will stop.
...That's a fair distinction, and I'll try to hear it as one.
How often. Right. I'd not counted, %1$s. Now I will.
Then tell me the number and I'll keep to it. I'm not unreasonable.
dialogue.conversations.cat.chitchat.food: What's good to eat around here?
dialogue.conversations.cat.chitchat.weat: What do you make of this weather?
dialogue.conversations.cat.events: News travels fast around here. What about it?
dialogue.conversations.cat.events.notice: How have you been, in yourself?
dialogue.conversations.cat.personal: Getting personal, are we? Go on, then.
dialogue.conversations.cat.personal.feel: How do you really feel about me?
dialogue.conversations.cat.personal.play: What do you make of me?
dialogue.conversations.cat.profession.wo: Do you actually like your work?
dialogue.conversations.cat.relationships: That's close to my heart. What is it?
dialogue.conversations.cat.village: The village, hm? What do you want to know?
dialogue.conversations.cat.village.neigh: Is there anyone on your mind?
dialogue.conversations.cat.village.peopl: What do you make of your neighbors?
dialogue.conversations.cat.village.stand: What do people think of me around here?
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again.apo: It's alright. Nice to be asked twice, honestly.
No harm in it, %1$s. My answer keeps.
Happens. I forget who I've told what, too.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again.lea: Go on. I'll have changed my answer by then, maybe.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again.pre: The same as an hour ago. I'd tell you if it had changed.
Asking twice doesn't get you a different life, %1$s. Just a shorter answer.
...Fine. Still fine. That's the whole of it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/1: You asked me that this morning, %1$s. Still the same answer.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/2: Twice in one day? Either you care a lot or you forgot you asked.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/3: Persistent today, aren't we? Same answer, warmer delivery.
More? It's %2$s. I've been eating since dawn and I intend to continue.
On a day like today, %1$s, the answer to 'how are you' is always 'full'.
Everything's better today and I'm not going to examine why too closely.
...More. Right. I've been trying to think of a reason to keep you here and you've handed me one.
You want the long version? From you, %1$s, you can have the very long version.
Ask me anything. Honestly. Ask me about the weather and I'd talk for an hour.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.child/1: Good! Mostly good. The goat and I have a truce now.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.child/2: I'm okay! I only fell in the pond once this whole week.
It was. And now it's said and unsaid, so we'll leave it.
So it is. Thank you for noticing without being told, %1$s.
...Right. Well. The week's still good. Mostly.
Most things that land badly were meant lightly.
I'll take that. Lightly said still has a weight, %1$s.
Then say the light thing lighter next time and we'll both be spared.
...Earned. I'll take that word and keep it, thank you.
You've a talent for putting a thing back the way you found it, %1$s.
Good. Taking it. Watch me take it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.glad.grat: Better than I was — that %2$s you brought me is still doing its work.
Well enough. I've the %2$s you gave me on the shelf where I can see it.
Good, and partly because of the %2$s. I've not forgotten.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.glad.hurt: ...You're bleeding. Sit down before you tell me how well you're doing.
Glad, are you. You look like you lost an argument with something large, %1$s.
Don't 'glad' me. Something's had a go at you. Sit.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.ask_: Small things stacking the right way for once. That's all it takes.
Sleep, mostly. And nobody needing anything urgently.
The work's been going well, and that spills into everything else.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.defl: You could have let me have the week.
Mm. There's a way of saying that which isn't a curse. That wasn't it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.glad: Thank you. People check in when it's bad and vanish when it isn't.
Genuinely, you say. I'll take genuinely.
So am I, honestly. It's been a while.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.keep: I intend to. Ask me again in a month and we'll see if I managed.
That's the plan. Plans and I have a history, mind.
Quite. Nice to be told to keep going rather than to slow down.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.leav: Aye, off you go. Enjoy yours.
Go on. I'll be here being suspiciously content.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.shar: Two of us doing alright at once. The village won't survive it.
Good. It's better when it's going round rather than pooling in one house.
Then we're both ahead. Let's not examine it too closely, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.teas: Must you? It was a nice moment.
I'm allowed a good week without commentary, %1$s.
Mm. And now I'm self-conscious about it. Well done.
Ruined already. Word'll be round the well by supper.
Hah! Don't you dare tell the baker. They'd never let it go.
A reputation for cheerfulness. The shame of it.
Let them talk. I've had worse rumours.
It'll pass before anyone notices, I expect.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/1: Honestly? Pretty good. The bread turned out right and nobody's yelled at me yet.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/2: Better now that someone actually asked. Most folks just want directions.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/3: Can't complain. Slept through the night, and the roof only leaks in one spot now.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.holiday.j: Then you understand the day properly. Most visitors don't.
Ha! A fellow professional. Come and find me at the long table.
Good. Anyone who eats before noon on this day is family, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.holiday.l: Do. There's a pie with my name on it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.holiday.t: Eat. Sit. Eat again. My family have refined it over generations.
There's a thing we do with the first loaf that I'll not explain sober, %1$s.
Nothing clever. That's the point of it — one day with nothing clever in it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.holiday.w: Every hour and two of tomorrow's, if I can manage it.
I will. You should too — nobody's working today, %1$s.
That's the correct thing to say to someone at a festival. Well done.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.hurt.ask_: Clean water and a strip of linen. It isn't magic, but it's what works.
The cleric has the good stuff. I have the stuff that stops it getting worse.
Aye. Hold still, %1$s, and stop telling me you're fine.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.hurt.expl: It always does, to the one wearing it. Sit anyway.
That's what everyone says on the way to the cleric, %1$s.
Then it looks very bad indeed, and I'd like the details.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.hurt.leav: You will. That was never the question.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.hurt.sit/: Good. Now don't talk for a bit and let it stop bleeding.
A moment's all I asked for. Thank you, %1$s.
There. The village will keep without you for a quarter hour.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.hurt.wave: I don't doubt it. That's not the comfort you think it is.
Then you've had worse and learned nothing from it, %1$s.
As you like. Bleed on someone else's doorstep.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late.ask_: Nothing I could name. That's the trouble — a named thing you can put down.
Tomorrow, mostly. It's very close at this hour, %1$s.
The list. Everyone's got a list and mine reads itself aloud around this time.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late.awak: Then the village has two of us and neither will admit it in daylight.
Ha. We should form a guild, %1$s. Meetings at three in the morning.
That's oddly steadying to hear. Misery does like the company.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late.keep: ...You'd sit up. With me. For no reason at all. Well. Pull the other stool over, then.
A while. Aye. It's better company than the list, %1$s.
Don't talk, mind. Just be here. That's the useful part.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late.leav: I'll try. Trying is most of what I do at this hour.
Mind how you go in the dark.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late.name: ...One of them, maybe. It's the roof. It's been the roof since spring.
If I could name them they'd be jobs, %1$s, and jobs I can do.
Naming them at this hour makes them bigger. I'll do it in daylight.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late.send: ...You're right. It will keep. It always keeps and I never believe it until somebody says so.
Just so. Bed. Thank you for the shove, %1$s.
Fair. Nothing at this hour ever looks the same size in the morning.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late.sit_: ...That's a kind way to spend an hour neither of us wanted.
So it is. Sit. The fire's still got an hour in it, %1$s.
Together. That's the whole difference between this hour and the last one.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late/1: Late to be about. I'm no better — I've been up since the fire went low.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late/2: You're up. So am I, and neither of us has a good reason, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late/3: This hour, the village belongs to whoever couldn't sleep. Welcome to it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.ask: Nothing you could put on a list. It's the weight of the ordinary, mostly.
A few things. None of them the sort you can hand to someone else.
Ask me on a better day and I'd say nothing at all. Today — a fair bit.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.dis: ...I will, yes. Thank you for the vote of confidence.
Always am. That's rather the problem, %1$s.
Mm. Suppose asking was the polite part and you've done it.
...It was. But you came back to it, which counts for more.
Thin, aye. Half the village does it without ever noticing, %1$s.
Accepted. Ask again tomorrow and I'll give you the real answer.
...Go on, then. Slowly, mind. I'm out of practice at being asked.
Properly. All right, %1$s. Sit down first — properly takes longer.
You may. I'll not make it easy, but you may.
Good. Pushing was never going to get it out of me anyway.
Quite. It'll keep, %1$s. Most of it always does.
So be it. Thank you for hearing the no.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.giv: That's the kindest version of leaving me alone I've heard.
Around, but not hovering. Aye. That's the useful kind.
Thank you. I'll come find you when I've words for it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.lea: Off you go. Thanks for stopping.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.lis: ...Alright. It's the hours, mostly. And nobody noticing them until now.
You'll actually wait for the answer. That's rarer than you'd think.
Then I'll say it: I'm tired in a way sleep doesn't fix.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.off: You've given me plenty today. Save some of yourself for tomorrow.
Enough, %1$s. Truly. Come back tomorrow and offer again and I'll say yes.
That's twice today. I'll not have it a third time — go and do something for yourself.
...The wood, then. If you meant it. Tuesday, and bring the good axe.
One thing. You're the first to make it that easy to answer.
Hah. Alright. I'll think of something and hold you to it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.sha: Everyone's had a stretch. I asked about mine.
Mm. And here I thought we were discussing me.
Good. Well. Glad you got through yours.
You have? ...Then you know it isn't the sort of thing advice fixes.
Somebody else in the same boat. Strangely, that helps.
Good. Not good for you — you know what I mean, %1$s.
Everyone has, I suppose. Doesn't make it lighter, but it's company.
It is. It goes round, doesn't it.
Then you'll know I'll be alright eventually. Eventually.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.ten: ...You're asking after me. After the other week. Alright — I'll answer, and we'll see how it goes.
Hm. Asking is a start. It's not the whole of it, %1$s, but it's a start.
I'll tell you, but I'll be watching how you take it. Old habits.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/1: You want the honest answer? It's been a heavy few days. Thanks for asking, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/2: Not my best morning. But you asking helps more than you'd think.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/3: I've been carrying more than my basket lately. It shows, huh?
dialogue.conversations.checkin.smitten.l: Very well. It began badly, improved without permission, and here we are.
You'll regret asking. I've been saving this up, %1$s.
The long version needs sitting down for. Are you sitting down?
dialogue.conversations.checkin.smitten.r: An hour. ...Right. I'm going to need a moment before I start, then.
Careful, %1$s. I'll hold you to the hour.
An hour of being listened to. I'll spend it badly and enjoy every minute.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.smitten.s: ...The weather. Right. It's fine, since you ask.
Understood. I'll not make it awkward, %1$s.
Fair. The offer keeps better than the moment does, anyway.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.teen/1: Fine, I guess. Same as yesterday.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.teen/2: Busy. Everyone suddenly wants me to do chores.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.toddler.a: The best bit was the bit at the start. Before everything else.
There were LOTS of best bits. That's why it's a good day.
The bit nobody saw. That one's mine. ...Okay, I'll tell you later.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.toddler.d: It IS a good report. I did a good one.
A REPORT. Like a proper one. I'm going to tell Mama I did a report.
Good report! Thank you, %1$s. I'll do another one tomorrow.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.toddler.l: Bye bye. Ask me again tomorrow, there'll be more.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.toddler/1: I'm good! I found a bug this morning. It wiggled.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.toddler/3: I got up ALL by myself today.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.young.dis: What did you want, a speech?
dialogue.conversations.checkin.young.enc: ...Am I? Don't say it in front of the others. ...But say it again sometime.
I am, aren't I! Mostly. Some days.
That's a good thing to hear before chores.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.young.int: The WHOLE thing? Right. Sit down.
Nobody ever asks for the whole thing! Okay, so —
You're going to regret that. It's a long one.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.young.lea: Okay. Come back later, I'll have news.
dialogue.conversations.checkin_child.pro: This week. I'm saying it out loud so you can't quietly mean next week.
Fair. I'll not mention it again until the day, and then I'll mention it a lot.
Good. I'd stopped expecting it, and I'd rather go back to expecting it.
That's what you said last time.
...Nobody says that to me. Grown people usually explain instead.
Alright. I'd been practising being angry about it and now I can't.
Then I'll stop counting. That was the only part I wanted.
The river. You said the river, twice, and it's been dry weather since.
You said I could have the small knife when I could sharpen the big one. I can.
You said you'd stop going out at night. I've been counting and I'd rather not say the number.
dialogue.conversations.checkin_child.reb: ...It was. Thank you for noticing before I had to explain it.
Careless. Aye. People are, about other people's children, %1$s.
Then we'll not speak of it again and I'll go on being insufferable about them.
...Nothing about them is light to me. That's the whole trouble.
Lightly. Right. I'd take the light version, if you have one, %1$s.
Then say the light one and I'll pretend I heard that first.
So I've found. Off you go, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.day.again.apologi: Happens. My days blur together too, if I'm honest.
No harm done, %1$s. Ask me tomorrow and I'll have new material.
That's alright. Half of me forgot I answered.
dialogue.conversations.day.again.leave/2: Go on. I'll have something new by evening.
dialogue.conversations.day.again.press/1: It's the same day, %1$s. It's been the same day for an hour.
dialogue.conversations.day.again.press/2: Asking twice doesn't get you a better answer. It gets you a shorter one.
dialogue.conversations.day.again.press/3: ...Fine. It's fine. It was fine before, too.
dialogue.conversations.day.again/1: Same day it was an hour ago, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.day.again/2: Still going. Days don't change that fast around here.
dialogue.conversations.day.again/3: The day refuses to get more interesting, I'm afraid.
dialogue.conversations.day.child/1: BEST day. I found a rock shaped like a slightly different rock!
dialogue.conversations.day.child/2: I raced the chickens and only lost twice. They cheat with the flapping.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.ask_more: Small things. Cold water, short queue, nobody needed anything urgently. That's the recipe.
Nothing went wrong. That's the whole of it. It's rarer than it sounds.
The bread came out right. You can build a whole day on that.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.celebrat: Earned it? I'll take that. Nobody says that around here.
Hah. Don't tell the others, they'll want one.
Maybe I have. Feels good to hear it said, anyway.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.deflate/: ...Right. Well. Sorry for having an hour that didn't hurt.
Everyone works, %1$s. Some of us also have days. Try one.
That's a way to take the shine off a thing.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.deflated: ...I will, thank you. It was a small one and I'd like it back.
Mean, aye. But said and taken back inside a minute, %1$s. That's rare.
Noted. Then it's still a good day and we'll say no more.
...Ah. Then say that first next time and I'll ask about yours.
That'll be it, then. Two people having different days at each other, %1$s.
Understood. Sit down and tell me about it, and I'll not mention mine.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.leave/1: Aye, off you go. Enjoy yours if you get one.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.leave/2: Just so. Good day to you, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.leave/3: Go on then. Don't let me keep you from the good weather.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.share_ow: Two of us having a good day. The village won't know what to do with itself.
Is that right? Good. It's better when it's going round.
Then we should quit while we're ahead, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.tease.fl: I am allowed one, you know. It doesn't need commentary.
Mm. And now I'm thinking about it, which rather spoils it.
Must you? It was going so well.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.tease.la: Let them think it! I'll deny it under questioning.
Happy? Slanderous. I'll have you know I'm merely not miserable.
Ha! Don't tell anyone. I've a reputation.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.tease.po: They'd be shocked, I'm sure. Let them be.
One day a season. That's the arrangement.
dialogue.conversations.day.good.wish_wel: So do I. Kind of you to say it out loud.
From your mouth to the weather's ears, %1$s.
It won't, but I appreciate the thought.
dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Good one, actually. The well water was cold and the queue at the smith was short.
dialogue.conversations.day.good/2: It's the kind of day where the chickens behave. I'll take it.
dialogue.conversations.day.good/3: Sun's out, boots are dry. That's a win around here.
dialogue.conversations.day.lighten.crit/: It WAS. Personally, deliberately, all day — and you're the first to say it out loud. Right. I'm laughing now and the day can go hang.
...You've gone and fixed it. One sentence. I was going to carry that mood till Thursday, %1$s, and now I can't.
dialogue.conversations.day.lighten.plain: Heh. It does rather feel like that, doesn't it.
Mm. Personally, aye. That's the word for it, %1$s.
Suppose you have to laugh. Or you'd do the other thing.
dialogue.conversations.day.ordinary.advi: Maybe. Maybe there's a reason it's done this way.
Everyone's got a faster way. Mine has the advantage of working.
Could I. Thank you. I'll add that to the list of things I'm apparently doing wrong.
Mm. I'm sure it looks simple from where you're stood.
Go on then... huh. That would be faster. Right. Noted.
Say that again? ...No, you're right. I've been doing it the long way.
Blunt. Useful. I'll take blunt and useful over polite any day.
dialogue.conversations.day.ordinary.ask_: This? Nothing clever. But it wants doing properly, and that takes as long as it takes.
Same as most days. Which is the point of it, really.
Ask me in an hour and I'll have something to show you.
dialogue.conversations.day.ordinary.hurr: ...You asked. Suppose I'll get back to it, then.
So be it. Wouldn't want to waste your time with an answer.
Mm. Next time just walk past, it's quicker for both of us.
dialogue.conversations.day.ordinary.leav: Aye. Mind the puddle by the gate.
Off you go. It'll all still be here.
dialogue.conversations.day.ordinary.let_: Appreciated. Stay if you like — quiet company is fine company.
That's the politest thing anyone's said to me today.
So it is. Talk's easier when the hands are busy anyway.
dialogue.conversations.day.ordinary.prai: ...Well. Not much call for saying so, but I am. Thank you.
Twenty years of it. You'd hope so.
That's landed better than you'd think, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.day.ordinary.shar: Then we're both having the same unremarkable day. Company, of a sort.
Ha. Solidarity in nothing much happening.
Good. Days like this are underrated, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.day.plain/1: Ordinary. Nothing's broken and nothing's on fire. I'll take ordinary.
dialogue.conversations.day.plain/2: It's a Tuesday sort of day. Even when it isn't.
dialogue.conversations.day.plain/3: Fine. Uneventful. Which around here counts as a small victory.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.apologi: ...Alright. It did come out wrong. We'll leave it there.
Accepted. Don't make a habit of it, %1$s.
Mm. Thank you for saying so. It's more than most manage.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.ask/1: The short version? Everything that could tip over, tipped over. In order.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.ask/2: Nothing dramatic. Just a hundred small things, all pulling the same direction.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.ask/3: It started with one small thing going wrong and got creative from there.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.brush_o: Suppose they do. Doesn't make this one lighter, but suppose they do.
Mm. That's the sort of thing people say when they'd rather not hear the answer.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.double_: No. It's not a tragedy. It's just mine, and you've made it heavier. Good day.
Then keep it to yourself next time. I've plenty to be getting on with.
Good. I'll remember you said that, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.empathi: It is, a bit. Nice of you to notice instead of telling me it could be worse.
Some days are just heavy. Thank you for not trying to fix it in one sentence.
That's all it needed, honestly. Somebody saying it out loud.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.leave/1: Go on, then. The day'll keep.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.leave/3: Fair enough. I'll be here, being tired at things.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.let_be/: ...No. I don't, do I. That's a relief, actually.
Everyone wants to make it into a lesson. You didn't. Thank you.
It can just be a bad day. Feels strange to be allowed that.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.lighten: ...I'm sure that's funny somewhere. Not in here.
Please don't. Not today. Today I'd rather it just be bad.
Mm. Very clever, %1$s. I'm going to go back to my day now.
Ha! It WAS. All day, personally, deliberately. Right — I feel better and I resent it.
You're terrible. ...That's the first time I've laughed since this morning.
Ha. Alright. Alright. Point to you.
Heh. Personally. Aye, that's about how it felt.
That's about the size of it, yes.
Suppose you have to laugh. Or you'd do the other thing.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.offer_h: You've done enough for one day. Sit down and let it be somebody else's turn.
Another time. You've been at it since morning, %1$s — I've been watching.
No. Kind of you, but there's a limit to how much one person should carry in a day.
You mean that? ...Alright. That's the first useful thing that's happened today.
Hands, not sympathy. You're a rare one, %1$s.
I'll take you up on that. Don't offer twice unless you mean it.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.tense/1: ...Mm. Thank you. It lands a bit flat coming from you just now, but thank you.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.tense/2: True enough. We're not quite square, you and I, but I'll take the sympathy, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.tense/3: That's kind. There's still a thing between us, mind. But that was kind.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Long. My back aches and the cat knocked the stew off the table.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/2: One of those days where the door sticks and everything else follows its lead.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/3: I dropped an egg, then a bucket, then my patience. In that order.
dialogue.conversations.day.teen/1: It's fine. It's a day. They keep happening whether I approve or not.
dialogue.conversations.day.teen/2: Chores, chores, being told I'm 'so grown up now', more chores. Riveting.
dialogue.conversations.day.toddler.ask/1: Lots. This many. No — THIS many.
dialogue.conversations.day.toddler.ask/2: It was big. Bigger than a duck.
dialogue.conversations.day.toddler.ask/3: I don't remember but it was GOOD.
dialogue.conversations.day.toddler.delig: It WAS the best! You get it!
dialogue.conversations.day.toddler.leave: Okay bye! I'm going to go do it again!
dialogue.conversations.day.toddler/1: I stacked mud! It was the best mud.
dialogue.conversations.day.toddler/2: Today is SO long. Is it snack time?
dialogue.conversations.day.toddler/3: I chased a butterfly and then it chased ME.
dialogue.conversations.day.working/1: Busy hands today. Ask me again when I've put this down.
dialogue.conversations.day.working/2: In the middle of it, as you can see. But it's honest work.
dialogue.conversations.day.working/3: You've caught me mid-chore. Talk while I work — the wood doesn't judge.
dialogue.conversations.day.young.ask_mor: Mostly, yeah. Some days are better. Today was a good one.
Depends on the day. Depends who's about.
More or less. It's alright here, mostly.
dialogue.conversations.day.young.dismiss: Understood. Grown-up news only. Got it.
You asked, though. That's the bit I don't get.
dialogue.conversations.day.young.encoura: It was, wasn't it! Nobody counts it as work but it IS.
...Huh. Thanks. Usually it's just 'that's nice' and then a change of subject.
See, that's what I keep saying.
dialogue.conversations.day.young.interes: Really? Nobody ever wants the long version. Right — so —
You actually want to hear it? Alright!
Hah. Fine. Sit down, this takes a minute.
dialogue.conversations.day.young.leave/3: Alright. Come back when you've got more time.
dialogue.conversations.day.young.play_al: AND THEN — right, so — you're the only one who ever lets me finish.
Then it got worse! In the good way!
You're going to regret asking. I've got three more.
dialogue.conversations.day.young.snubbed: ...Okay. Do you want to hear it properly, then?
Grown-ups don't say sorry to me much. Alright.
Fine. But you have to actually listen this time, %1$s.
...Right. So it started at the well, and it got better from there.
You'd better be. It's a good one and I've been saving it.
Okay. But it's shorter now because you ruined the beginning.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate/: That question belongs to someone I trust with everything. We're not there.
Ask me again when you've earned it, %1$s. That one costs more than hearts on a sleeve.
Some doors open slowly. Keep showing up and maybe.
There are maybe two people alive who get that answer. Working on whether you're the third.
Not yet. And 'yet' is doing a lot of kind work in that sentence.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal/: That's... a bit close to the bone for someone I barely know.
Maybe when I know you better, %1$s. Words like that need trust first.
Buy me a sweetroll first. Then we'll see about the deep questions.
I keep that shelf locked. Come back when we're friends, not acquaintances.
You get the weather and the crops, %1$s. The rest costs friendship.
My mother said never hand a stranger your heart or your ladder. I lost the ladder that way.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.secret/1: Secrets are traded, not given. Trust me with something of yours first.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.secret/2: You first, %1$s. That's how secrets work.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.secret/3: When you've told me something that matters, I'll match it. That's the deal.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.again.apol: It's alright. Saying it twice in a day makes it sound less likely, that's all.
No harm, %1$s. It hasn't moved on since breakfast, but I appreciate the interest.
Happens. I'd rather be asked twice than not at all, if I'm honest.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.again.leav: Aye. Catch me later in the week.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.again.pres: Same one as this morning. It's not the sort of thing that gets a new version by noon.
You'll get the same answer with less enthusiasm, %1$s. That's what asking twice buys you.
...Fine. But if it sounds smaller this time that's your doing, not mine.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.again/1: You know my dream already. Saying it twice won't make it come faster.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.again/2: My dream hasn't changed since this morning, %1$s. They move slower than that.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.again/3: Still the same dream. Still saving up for it.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.child/1: I'm gonna be a knight AND a baker. Sword in one hand, cake in the other. It's decided.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.child/2: I want a pet slime! A LITTLE one. It can sleep in the boot box.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.close.conf: ...Then we're two fools with plans, and that's a better number than one.
You've got one too. Good. I'd started to think I was the only one still doing that, %1$s.
Trade you. And if either of us gets there, the other one hears about it first.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.close.hone: ...Then we're two fools with plans and no obligations to each other. Perfect arrangement.
You've one of your own and you're not asking me to carry it either. Good, %1$s.
Trade you. No promises attached, on either side.
So do I. Off you go, and thank you for the honest version.
So you are. Mind how you go, %1$s.
Quite. It'll happen or it won't, and you were straight with me about which you'd help with.
...It did. More so knowing you'd not pretend to be more use than you are.
Saying it to somebody who won't help is the purer test. It's still a want either way.
You noticed. I'd rather be heard honestly than helped carelessly, %1$s.
You're welcome. And you didn't dress it up as help you weren't going to give, which I'll remember.
Just so, well. An honest 'no' keeps better than a friendly 'maybe', %1$s.
Hm. Thank you for hearing it without immediately volunteering for it.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.close.leav: Aye. Go on, and thank you.
So be it. Enough of that for one day.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.close.say_: ...It did. Wanting a thing out loud is how people find out you might fail at it.
Saying it makes it real enough to be disappointed by. That's the cost of it.
You noticed that. Everyone thinks a dream is the easy thing to talk about, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.close.than: Don't thank me yet. Thank me if it ever turns into anything.
You're welcome. Saying it to someone makes it feel a bit more like a plan, %1$s.
True enough, well. It cost me nothing to say and rather a lot to admit. Both of those are true.
That's kind. But dreams cost coin, and mine's mostly spoken for.
You sound like my grandmother. She was usually right, which is the annoying part.
Easy for you to say — you've seen the world past the wheat line.
You think so? Then maybe I'll actually do it. Watch me, %1$s.
Careful — encourage me and I might drag you along.
Say that again sometime. It works better than coffee.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/1: Don't laugh. I want to see the ocean once. Just once. Smell the salt.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/2: I dream about a bigger garden. And once, flying. The garden feels more likely.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/3: Someday I want to build something that outlasts me. A bridge, maybe. Or a family.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.followup.b: That's better than a promise you'd break. Thank you for the honesty.
Glad I told you. That's enough on its own, most days.
No promises. Good. I've had promises. I'd rather have the truth.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.followup.m: ...Yes. Me. Doing that. Thank you for the vote of confidence, %1$s.
I'll not mention it again. To you, anyway.
That's the reaction I was afraid of. Well done.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.followup.p: ...You mean that? Then it's the first time it's been more than mine.
Careful what you promise, %1$s. I'll hold you to it and I'll enjoy it.
Help. Right. Then you can start by holding the other end of things while I swear at them.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.guarded.as: Ask me what I did today. That one's free and it's mostly fence posts.
The small wants I'll give you. It's the big one I'm keeping under a cloth, %1$s.
Something I've already done, then. Those are finished and safe to look at.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.guarded.le: Off you go. We'll get there or we won't.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.guarded.pr: Said out loud too early, a thing like that goes flat. I've watched it happen.
You want to hear it so you can tell me whether it's sensible. I know how this goes, %1$s.
No. It's half-built. Nobody gets shown a house with no roof on it.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.guarded.re: ...Thank you. It's easier to keep building when nobody's stood over it judging the shape.
Just so. Ask me again when there's something to actually look at, %1$s.
Good. Half-built things don't survive an opinion.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.mocked.apo: ...Hm. Ask me in a month and I might. Might.
You were wrong about it, aye. Say so once more and I'll believe you, %1$s.
Then I'll keep it where it was and pretend the last minute didn't happen.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.mocked.exp: ...Surprised. That's a better word than the one I'd landed on.
There's a difference, and you'll forgive me for not hearing it at the time.
Then next time make the surprised noise instead of the other one, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.more/1: More? Alright. In the dream there's a porch, and nobody needs anything from me until noon.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.more/2: There's a second part I don't tell everyone. There's a dog in it. A big, useless, happy one.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.more/3: Details? In the dream nobody knocks on my door before breakfast. Pure fantasy.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.no_words/1: ...That's fair. It's a daft thing to want out loud and you've not laughed, which is plenty.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.no_words/2: You don't have to have an opinion on it, %1$s. It's not a proposal, it's a want.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.no_words/3: Nothing to say is better than 'that's nice'. I've had a great deal of 'that's nice'.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.rebuked.ap: ...No. I've a rope and a tape of my own for that.
I count it every night, %1$s. I don't need help with the arithmetic.
Thank you. That's the apology I'd have written for you.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.rebuked.ex: ...Oh. That's a different sentence and I heard the other one.
Then you're kinder than you sound, %1$s. Say the kind half first.
Hurt by it. Aye, well. Wanting something always costs that.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.rebuked.le: Understood. It'll still be a long way tomorrow.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.respond.as: You want the details? Nobody wants the details.
Right — so it starts with the workshop, and gets ambitious from there.
Careful. Ask twice and you'll get the whole plan, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.respond.en: ...Should I? Saying it out loud to someone makes it feel less daft.
Everyone else tells me to be sensible. You're the first who didn't.
Chase it. Right. I'll think about what that would even look like.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.respond.le: So do I. Thank you for not laughing at it.
Very well. Back to the actual day, then.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.respond.re: ...I know how far it is. I didn't need it measured out.
Thank you. I'd almost forgotten to feel small about it.
Everything's a long way from here, %1$s. That's the point of wanting it.
It is. That's the useful thing to hear and nobody says it.
A long way. Aye. Better to know the distance than pretend there isn't one.
Straight with me. Good. I'd rather that than encouragement I can't use.
It is a long way. I've counted the steps more than once.
It is. Doesn't stop it being the thing I want.
True enough. Most worthwhile things are.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.ask: You never told me it would work. You came back to ask anyway. That's why I'm still at it.
Somebody who said the hard thing and still wants to know how it's going — aye, a little closer.
You promised me nothing, %1$s. It makes the asking mean more, not less.
You said you'd help. I waited a bit, then got on with it alone. That's usually how it goes.
Some. On my own, mostly — you'd offered, and then the days went by, %1$s.
It's moved. Not because of the offer, if I'm honest. But you're asking now, and that's something.
A little. Slowly. But you asking is more than most do.
Not much. It's still there, though, which is something.
Some days closer, some further. Today, closer.
You said you'd help, and you came back to ask. That counts for a great deal.
Closer, aye — partly because somebody was going to ask me.
I've moved on it. I'd not have, if you hadn't offered, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.dou: ...Still, yes. That's rather how wanting something works.
You asked me about it once. I thought you cared.
So I've found. Still on about it. I'll keep it to myself in future.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.fol: You say that like it's obvious. It isn't, but I'll borrow your version for a bit.
Just so. Well. It's easier to keep at a thing when somebody's watching to see if you do.
I'll get there. ...I said that out loud and it didn't sound stupid, %1$s. That's new.
It might not. I know. I'd rather hear that from you than from myself at three in the morning.
That's the truth of it, aye. Doesn't stop me. But it's good that one of us says it.
Not many will say that. They nod and move on. ...I'd rather be told, %1$s.
True enough, go on. It'll still be here in the morning, worse luck.
Just so. Back to it, then.
Off you go, %1$s. Thanks for asking after it.
The next step. Nobody asks that. They ask if I'm still doing it, which isn't the same question.
Right — the next step is the boring one. Which is why it's still the next one.
Give me a moment. ...There. Written on the inside of my head. Thank you for making me say it.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.lea: I will. Thank you for remembering it at all.
So be it. Back to the possible things.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.off: The first step. Nobody breaks it down like that. ...Alright, here it is.
You'd help with the small dull part? That's the part that never gets done.
Noted. One step. I can manage one step with company, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.revisit/1: Still dreaming about what I told you. It hasn't gotten smaller.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.revisit/2: You remembered my dream? Careful, %1$s, I might start believing in it again.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.revisit/3: Since you asked last time, I've saved four emeralds toward it. Four! It begins.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.teen/1: Somewhere that isn't here, doing something nobody assigned me. That's the whole dream so far.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.teen/2: Don't laugh — I've been practicing the bow when nobody's watching. I'm getting good.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.toddler.as: You just do it. You do it and then it's done. That's how.
Eating. Eating makes you get big and then you can do anything.
Practising. Every day. Except some days 'cause of naps.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.toddler.de: You BELIEVE me. Nobody says that, they just laugh and go 'aww'.
Then it's happening. It's decided. You said it and now it's decided.
I KNOW. I'm going to be it so much, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.toddler.le: Bye! I'm going to go practise being it.
Bye bye. You'll see. You'll ALL see.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.toddler/2: A pony! Or a dog. Or a pony-dog.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.toddler/3: I dreamed I was a bee last night. It was great.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.young.dism: ...Everyone says that. Everyone said it to everyone who ever did anything, too.
You don't know that. Nobody knows that yet, including me.
Fine. Then I'll do it and not tell you about it.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.young.enco: ...You think I could? Most people say 'we'll see' in the voice that means no.
I COULD, couldn't I. I'm going to remember you said that.
That's the first time anyone's said it back without the face. Thanks, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.young.inte: Really? Alright — so it's got three parts and the third one's the good one.
You want the WHOLE plan? Nobody wants the whole plan. Sit down.
Good. It starts small and it gets very big by the end. Don't laugh at the middle.
dialogue.conversations.family.ask_parent: Can I ask you something? Parent to child?
dialogue.conversations.family.checkin_ch: How are you holding up, little one?
dialogue.conversations.family.child.agai: You already asked! Nothing new happened since then. Well. One thing. No, nothing.
Still the same as before. You keep checking like I might've broken.
I'm FINE. I was fine the first time you asked, too.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.dism: That's a thing said by someone without any, %1$s.
Understood. I'll stop telling you about them, then.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.doin: Pretty good! I beat the miller's kid at races twice. TWICE.
Good! I taught the cat to sit. It sat for entirely unrelated reasons but STILL.
I grew this much since you last asked! At least this much.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.guid: ...That's useful. Actually useful, not the usual advice.
You've thought about this. Say it again, slower.
I'll try it. If it works I'll say it was my idea.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.leav: Quite. They'll want feeding shortly anyway.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.list: ...Really are. Right. Not as well as I tell people, if I'm honest.
You want the true answer about them. That's kind of you to ask for.
Better than last month. Worse than I'd like. That's children.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.litt: Up! Up! I found a bug and it's my friend now!
I'm gonna be tall tomorrow. I decided.
I ate a flower today. Don't tell the flower.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.play: They ARE. Don't tell them I agreed with you.
Wonderful and exhausting, in that order.
Ha! You'd change your mind by supper, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.prai: ...Am I? Some days I'm certain I'm not.
That's the thing nobody says to a parent. Thank you, %1$s.
I try. It's good to be told the trying shows.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.scol: ...A firmer hand. That's not what they need.
Mm. I'll pretend you didn't say that.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.teen: I'm fine. Everyone keeps asking. I'm FINE. ...Thanks for asking, though.
Can I have more responsibility and also no responsibility? Is that a thing?
dialogue.conversations.family.close.say_: ...It did. More than I'd say out loud.
Then it was worth the saying.
Good. We don't say enough, in this family.
dialogue.conversations.family.close.than: Family doesn't need thanking. But you're welcome.
True enough, well. That's what we're for, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.a: You've one I don't know? Go on — I'll not interrupt. Much.
Ha! Then we're trading, and I want the good one.
New to me. That's rare after all this time, %1$s.
I told you the good one already. The rest need supper and a fire to come out right.
You've had your story for the week. Family rates apply.
Later. A story told twice too soon goes stale like bread.
More? Careful — I've a great many and no shame.
Very well, there's the one about the goat. You'll regret asking.
You're the first to ask for a second one, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.b: You weren't there for that one.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.d: ...I do always tell that one. It's a good one.
Then I'll find a new one, %1$s.
Noted. I'll spare you the rest.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.l: We've built a stock of these, you and I. That's what a family is, in the end.
Another one for the pile. There'll be more, %1$s.
You've heard half of these twice and you still laugh. That counts for something.
You'd forgotten! I've told that one at every feast for six years.
Ha! Then it's worth telling again.
Good. It's better when somebody's hearing it fresh.
Just so. Another time, and I'll have a better one.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.q: ...It might have been the other summer. Doesn't spoil it.
You're checking my facts. In MY story.
Sure enough. Sure-ish. Let me have it.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.s: Did I ever tell you about the winter my uncle got snowed into the outhouse? No? Sit down.
There's a story about my brother and a runaway pig that this family swore to keep secret. Anyway...
Ask my mother about the beehive someday. Watch her face. That's the whole story right there.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.t: There's one I always come back to. Sit down.
Family stories. I've a hundred and you'll hear at least one.
Ha — where do I start. The goat, probably.
'Member when we saw the sheep? That was the best day of my LIFE.
One time you were here and I showed you my rock. You 'member.
I remember breakfast. It was good.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.aga: You've had one question out of me today. Save the next for when it's heavier.
Ask me twice and you'll get the same advice, only shorter.
That question again? Go on, then. But I'm no wiser than I was an hour ago.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.ans: ...Thank you. You've never fobbed me off, and I notice.
The truth. Right. That's all I was after.
Good. I'd rather a hard true thing than a soft false one.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.ask: ...You want to know what I worry about? Nobody's asked me that.
Everything. Mostly you. That's the honest answer.
The usual things a person worries about, and one or two more.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.def: Mm. I'll ask again next week.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.lea: So it is. Mind how you go.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.pro: You turned out well, you know. I don't say it enough. I'm saying it now.
Ask away. Though watching you lately, you need less advice than you think.
Whatever you're about to ask — yes, I'm proud of you. Now what was it?
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.rea: I'll worry anyway. That's the arrangement, %1$s.
...Alright. I'll try to worry less. No promises.
It helps to hear it. It doesn't stop it, but it helps.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.sna: Fussing. Is that what it looks like from there?
Very well. I'll leave you be, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.tha: ...You're welcome. It's the only useful thing I do.
Thanked for asking. Well. That's new, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.wor: I worry, that's all. It's the job. You never stop being someone's parent.
You look thinner. Are you eating? Don't make that face, it's my job to ask.
I still check the door at night wondering if you're safe out there. Old habit.
dialogue.conversations.family.resume.adm: ...Honest, at least. Anyone else would have pretended and I'd have known.
You forgot. Right. I'd rather that said out loud than performed at me.
Everyone forgets. Not everyone says so. I'll take the saying so.
dialogue.conversations.family.resume.ask: ...Next time. People say that. You'd be the first who did it twice.
Do. It's easier to answer the second time than the first.
Fair. I'll have something to tell you, then. That's a good reason to have something.
Better than I expected and worse than I'd hoped, which is most of family.
It went. That's the honest answer and it took a while to be able to give it.
Nothing's fixed. But nobody's stopped talking either, and that's the good news.
dialogue.conversations.family.resume.jus: ...That is better. I hadn't known I was allowed to want that one.
Then sit down. I'll get to it in my own order and it won't be the tidy one.
Listening. Yes. Everyone else arrives with a plan and I've plans enough.
dialogue.conversations.family.resume.kee: ...You did. People say they will. You're the first who came back about it.
You remembered. I'd made myself not expect that, and I was wrong to.
That matters more than the thing itself did. I'd not know how to say why.
dialogue.conversations.family.resume.lea: So be it. Thanks for coming back about it at all.
Off you go. I'll be about if it comes up again.
Fine. It's said now, which is more than it was.
dialogue.conversations.family.resume.off: ...Actually help. Nobody says actually. They say 'anything at all' and mean nothing.
Come by on a Thursday. That's it. That's the whole of what would help.
Ask me again in front of them. That would do more than anything you could carry.
dialogue.conversations.family.resume.say: ...Glad. Right. I'd braced for the other thing, so that's landed oddly.
So am I, and I'd not have said so an hour ago.
Then it was worth saying. I wasn't sure it would be.
dialogue.conversations.family.revisit/1: I've been thinking about what we talked about. The family thing. I didn't forget it.
dialogue.conversations.family.revisit/2: You remember what I told you, about us? I've been waiting to see if you did.
dialogue.conversations.family.revisit/3: That thing about my family — it hasn't gone anywhere since. I thought you should know.
dialogue.conversations.family.scolded.ap: ...I do. And most days I've no idea, which is the honest part of it.
Thank you. Everyone has a plan for somebody else's child, %1$s.
True enough. Come and watch them for an afternoon and you'll see what I mean.
dialogue.conversations.family.scolded.le: Good. It's the one thing I'd rather nobody helped with.
dialogue.conversations.family.scolded.so: ...Somebody to notice when it's gone right. That's it. That's the whole method.
Time and a soft voice, mostly, %1$s. It's slower and it works.
To be asked, the way you just asked me. Nobody asks a child anything.
dialogue.conversations.fears.again.apolo: It's alright. It's not the sort of thing that gets easier by repetition.
No harm. Ask me in a few days and I'll have found new words.
Appreciated, %1$s. Twice in a day is a lot to ask of anyone.
dialogue.conversations.fears.again.leave: Good. Catch me when the week's turned.
Good. Some things want a gap between them.
dialogue.conversations.fears.again.press: I already showed you that scar. Don't poke it twice in one week.
Twice? Buy me a drink first, %1$s.
Let it rest. It bites when it's poked fresh.
dialogue.conversations.fears.again/1: I already showed you that scar, %1$s. Don't poke it twice in one week.
dialogue.conversations.fears.again/2: Twice in one week you want my nightmares? Buy me a drink first.
dialogue.conversations.fears.again/3: Let that one rest, %1$s. It bites when it's poked fresh.
dialogue.conversations.fears.challenge: You could face it. I'd stand with you.
dialogue.conversations.fears.challenge.c: ...Nobody ever offered the 'with you' part before. That's the part that matters. Alright. Next time it comes, I don't run. Witnessed.
You'd actually stand there with me. Huh. — Fine. I'm holding you to it, and you're holding me to it.
dialogue.conversations.fears.challenge.g: That's easy to say from where you're standing. We're not there yet, you and I.
Face it. Just like that. ...Know a person before you volunteer them for bravery, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.fears.challenge.p: Easy for you — you've got somewhere else to be when it goes wrong. ...But it wasn't nothing, you offering.
Hm. Half of me believes you. The other half keeps the accounts.
Face it. You say that like it's a door I could just walk through.
Maybe. Ask me when it's actually in front of me and we'll both find out.
I've been told that before. It lands differently coming from you, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.fears.challenge.r: Don't make my fear a test of your character, %1$s. It isn't yours to be brave about.
Stand with me? You'll be gone by frost like everyone else. No.
dialogue.conversations.fears.challenge.s: Maybe. With a witness, maybe. Don't let me back out of it later.
You make it sound almost possible. Ask me again when it's close, and we'll learn what I'm made of.
dialogue.conversations.fears.child/1: The under-the-bed place. Papa checked it but monsters KNOW when papas leave.
dialogue.conversations.fears.child/2: Thunder. But only the loud kind. The rumbly kind is the sky's tummy and that's fine.
dialogue.conversations.fears.comfort.bru: I'm fine. Forget I said anything. The thunder and I have an understanding.
Yes, well. Enough about that. How's the weather treating you?
Don't make it a thing. It's not a thing. It's a perfectly reasonable dread.
dialogue.conversations.fears.comfort.cri: ...You mean that. You're not just being polite. Then here's the part I never say out loud: it's worse when nobody knows. It's smaller already.
Careful, %1$s. Kindness like that makes a person start hoping. ...Too late. Hoping.
dialogue.conversations.fears.comfort.pla: It is. It sits with me most days. ...Thank you for not making a face about it.
That's kind. It doesn't fix anything, but it's kind, and I'll take it.
Mm. Saying it to somebody who doesn't laugh takes a bit of the edge off.
dialogue.conversations.fears.comfort.reb: Don't. I didn't hand you that so you could pat it on the head.
Soft words, %1$s? It isn't a soft thing. Leave it be.
dialogue.conversations.fears.comfort.tha: ...Thank you. Most people change the subject.
Funny how a fear shrinks a little every time somebody doesn't laugh at it.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: Honestly? Thunder. And the thing that scratched at my door two winters back. Mostly the thunder.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/2: Being forgotten. Everyone remembers the mayor. Nobody remembers who fixed the well.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/3: The dark past the last lantern. Everyone pretends they're not afraid of it. They're lying.
dialogue.conversations.fears.followthrou: Slowly. But slowly is a direction, which is more than I had.
Two bad nights, one fine one. I'll take the arithmetic.
Better than it was. Ask me again next week and we'll see if I'm lying.
...It isn't nothing, is it. I keep telling myself it's nothing.
Don't make me proud of it, I'll get insufferable.
Someone noticing is half of why it worked, %1$s.
The next hard bit is the one where nobody's watching. Those are always the worst ones.
Doing it twice. Once was luck. Twice is a person changing, and that's heavier.
Telling someone else. ...Not yet. You were the practice run, and you don't know how hard that was.
So I've found. No fuss. That's how I'd want it.
Just so. Off you go.
Go on, %1$s. And thank you for the asking.
A long way. ...I hadn't measured it from the start. I'd only been measuring from here to the end.
Have I? Turn round and look back, you said. I never do that. It's further than I thought.
That's a kind way to put it, %1$s. And an accurate one, which is rarer.
Not finished. ...I'd been treating it like a job with an end to it. It isn't, is it.
That takes the hurry out of it. I didn't know the hurry was most of the weight.
No deadline. Right. I'll breathe out, then, %1$s.
Aye. Best not to stare at it too long.
Very well. Off you go. It's still there, but it's smaller.
Go on. And thank you for keeping track.
You did say that. ...It's been a while since, mind. I'd started filling in the blank myself.
I remember the promise, %1$s. I remember the days after it, too, and you weren't in many of them.
Just so, you said it. People do say it. I'd stopped counting on it, is all.
There wasn't a promise, %1$s. You've just kept turning up, which I've decided counts for more.
I don't recall you swearing to anything. You've simply been about. That's its own sort of word.
No oath between us. Only the asking, over and over. I'd not trade that for an oath.
You did say that. And you turned up, which is the rarer half of a promise.
I know. I've been keeping the receipt, %1$s. You're square with me.
Not alone, you said. It turns out that was the useful bit.
You didn't promise anything. I remember. That's why I believed the rest of it.
You were honest instead of kind. It wore better than kind would have.
No promises from you, %1$s. And here you are anyway, asking.
dialogue.conversations.fears.guarded.ask: Now that I can do. Ask me about the crops, or the roof, or the cat.
Something easier. Aye. Let's start there and work up.
Sensible. Small talk first, %1$s. That's how it's built.
dialogue.conversations.fears.guarded.lea: Off you go. No hard feelings.
So you are. We'll get there or we won't.
dialogue.conversations.fears.guarded.pre: I said no. Do you want to hear it a second time?
You'll be wanting my savings next. It's a no, %1$s.
Pushing at a locked door only tells me about you.
dialogue.conversations.fears.guarded.res: ...Aye. It is mine. Thank you for hearing that the first time.
Most people push. You didn't. That buys you something, %1$s.
Good. Ask me again in a season and we'll see.
dialogue.conversations.fears.lapsed.apol: ...Well. That's more than most would say. It's not undone, but it's said, and that helps.
You could have argued. You didn't. ...Alright, %1$s. We're not square, but we're speaking.
Mm. Owning it costs something. I noticed you paid it.
dialogue.conversations.fears.lapsed.leav: No excuses. Aye — that's the right call, and I'd have thought less of a good one.
Off you go, then. It's not the end of anything, %1$s. It's just a thing that happened.
So be it. We'll leave it where it is and see what you do next.
dialogue.conversations.fears.lapsed.make: Now, you mean. ...Right. Now will do. Now is the only bit anyone can actually offer.
Then be here, and we'll say no more about the gap, %1$s.
Alright. Second time of asking. I'd not give everyone that.
dialogue.conversations.fears.no_words/1: ...Nor did I, for years. That's rather the whole trouble with it. We'll sit here not knowing together.
dialogue.conversations.fears.no_words/2: You don't need words, %1$s. You've stayed in the room, which is the harder half.
dialogue.conversations.fears.no_words/3: Neither do I. Alright. That's oddly the most comforting thing anyone's managed.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.challe: ...Nobody ever offered the 'with you' part before. That's the part that matters. Alright. Next storm, I'll stand in the doorway.
You'd actually stand there with me. Huh. Fine. I'm holding you to it, and you're holding me to it.
Easy for you — you've somewhere else to be when it goes wrong.
Hm. Half of me believes you. The other half keeps the accounts.
Maybe I could. Not today, but maybe.
That's a thought I'll be carrying around now. Thanks for that.
You say it like it's simple. It might even be.
Don't make my fear a test of your character. It isn't yours to be brave about.
Face it, you say. You'll be gone by frost like everyone else.
Maybe. With a witness, maybe. Don't let me back out of it later.
You make it sound almost possible. Ask me again when it's close.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.close_: Aye. Go on. And %1$s — thank you.
Noted. Enough of that. Mind how you go.
Off with you. We'll pretend this was about the weather.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.comfor: ...You mean that. You're not just being polite. Then here's the part I never say: it isn't the thing itself. It's that I'd be alone in it.
Careful, %1$s. Kindness like that makes a person put the whole thing down. ...There. It's down.
Mm. It is. Not much to be done about it, though.
You're being kind. I never know what to do with kind, so I generally stand here and say nothing.
That's... yes. It is hard to carry. Thank you for saying so.
Most people go quiet when I say it. You didn't.
Heavy's the word for it, aye.
Don't. I didn't hand you that so you could pat it on the head.
Soft words, %1$s? It isn't a soft thing. Leave it be.
...That helps. I've no idea why saying it aloud to someone helps, but it does.
Right. Something's come off my shoulders and I'd rather not examine it too closely.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.disclo: Longer than I've lived in this house. It came with me, like a piece of furniture I keep meaning to leave behind.
Since I was small enough to fit under a table. I remember the table better than the reason.
Long enough that I'd stopped thinking of it as a thing that started. It's just weather, to me.
...You say that like it's a sack of grain. Like it's a thing that divides up. Alright. Take a corner of it, then.
It doesn't work like that. ...Except it does, apparently, because it's lighter and you've done nothing but stand there, %1$s.
Then it isn't mine alone any more. I don't know what to do with that. Something good, I expect.
So it is. That's plenty. ...Thank you for hearing the whole of it, %1$s.
Enough. Go on. I've said more today than in the last year of days.
Good. Off with you, before I say a third thing I can't take back.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.leave/: Aye. Thank you for not making a thing of it.
Go on. It'll keep until next time, %1$s.
Understood. Well. That's enough honesty for one afternoon.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.means/: ...It did. More than I'd like to admit standing here.
Getting it past my own teeth was the hard part. You just had to not flinch.
Noticed that, did you. Most don't.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.pledge: ...I know you will. That's the strange part — I said it and then realised I already believed it.
I'd not have told you this a year ago, %1$s. I'd not have told anyone. Hold on to that.
You don't have to promise. You've been doing it for months without the word attached.
...Nobody's said that before. I'm holding you to it, %1$s.
Not alone. Right. I'll try to believe that.
Careful what you promise. I remember promises.
...You don't flinch, do you. Alright. The rest of it, the true shape — and it stays between us.
Persistent. And gentle about it, which is worse. ...Fine. All of it, then.
Some of it, maybe. Not tonight. Tonight's too much like the night it happened.
That thread's still attached to something. Later. I mean later, not never.
There's more to it. Whether you get it is another question.
Bold, asking for the rest. Give me a moment with that.
Mm. Not sure I've decided how much of it you get.
I said what I said. The rest is mine. Leave it.
No. Some doors you don't knock on twice in a day, %1$s.
There's more, yes. Give me a breath. ...There. Two of us carrying it now.
You pull gently, I'll give you that. A little more of it, then.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.rebuff: ...That's the right answer, and I didn't expect it. Sit there a minute, if you like.
Good. Not everything wants handling. Some of it just wants somebody stood nearby.
Very well. You listen well when you stop trying to help, %1$s. That's not an insult.
...Aye. Well. I'm prickly about it, and you weren't to know. We'll call it even.
It did. But I've the shorter fuse where that's concerned. Let's leave it there, %1$s.
Mm. Thank you for not arguing the point. Most would have.
True enough. Go on. I'll be less of a hedgehog tomorrow.
Off you go. It's not you I'm cross with, for what it's worth.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.share/: You too? Huh. It's less heavy when two people carry it.
Strange comfort, that. Two cowards make one brave pair.
Then we watch each other's backs. That's how it's meant to work.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.step_b: ...That's honest. I'd rather that than a promise you'd break.
Good. People promise too easily around here. Listening is enough.
No promises. Understood. You still stayed, though.
We've talked it thin for one day. Come back and we'll pick it up where it is.
Enough for today. There's only so much of a thing you can say before it stops meaning anything, %1$s.
Quite. Let it rest now. It'll still be here, and so will I.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.thank/: Don't thank me. I didn't do anything except stop pretending for a minute.
It's not a gift, %1$s. It's just true. Still — aye. You're welcome.
Trust's a strange thing to be thanked for. I'll take it.
dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.ask_wh: Honestly? I don't know. Huh. That's a worse answer than I expected to give. Right — next question.
What would help. Huh. Give me a moment with that one.
Not being talked out of it, for a start.
You remember all of it, don't you. Even the part I nearly didn't say. ...Company. That's what helps.
You remembered by morning. Nine in ten don't. Not being alone with it — that's the answer.
Since you actually listened the first time: someone knowing. That's most of it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.follow: You'll be there. Then it's a plan and not a wish, which is the whole difference.
So be it. Then I can't quietly not do it, can I. That's the useful part of telling someone.
Good. I'll hold you to it, %1$s, and you hold me to mine.
You can't promise. Good. I've had promises. I'd rather have somebody who counts the cost first.
'I'll try' is a real thing. 'I promise' is usually a way of ending a conversation.
That'll do. That'll do very well, in fact.
It is. It's waited this long, it can wait for a good day.
Off you go, %1$s. I'll keep thinking on it.
Easier. ...If it were smaller. If it were one step instead of the whole staircase.
Daylight would help. Everything's twice the size after dark, I've noticed.
Somebody standing where I can see them. That's all. That's the entire list, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.just_l: ...No plan. Just this. That's better than a plan, actually.
Everyone wants to fix it. You just stood there. Thank you.
Being here is the whole of it, some days.
dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.leave/: Aye. It'll wait. It's good at waiting.
Go on. We'll pick it up.
Right. Thank you for coming back to it at all.
dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.offer_: Do something about it. You make it sound like a chore list. ...Maybe it is.
Alright. Something small, then. I'm not promising heroics.
A plan. Aye — written down, in order, with a first step small enough to actually do, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.fears.press: Tell me the rest of it.
dialogue.conversations.fears.press.crit/: ...You don't flinch, do you. Alright. The rest — the true shape of it, the part I skip even alone at night. Sit down. I've never told anyone this.
Persistent. And gentle about it, which is worse. ...Fine. The whole of it, then. But it stays between us, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.fears.press.guard: The rest isn't for sale, %1$s. It's not even for borrowing. Not yet.
There's a door in that story I don't open for acquaintances. No offense meant.
dialogue.conversations.fears.press.parti: Some of it, maybe. Not tonight. Tonight's too much like the night it happened.
That thread's still attached to something, %1$s. Later. I mean it — later, not never.
dialogue.conversations.fears.press.plain: There's more to it. Whether you get it today is a different question.
Bold of you. Give me a moment to decide how much of it you're having.
Mm. The rest isn't a story I tell standing up.
dialogue.conversations.fears.press.rebuf: I said what I said. The rest is mine. Leave it.
No. Some doors you don't knock on twice in a day, %1$s. I'd have thought you knew that.
dialogue.conversations.fears.press.succe: There's more, yes. Give me a breath. ...There. Now two of us are carrying it, and it's strange how much lighter that is.
You pull gently, I'll give you that. All right — a little more of it. The rest another day.
dialogue.conversations.fears.pressed.bac: ...Thank you. Not many people can stop when they're told to.
That's the right answer, %1$s. I'll remember you gave it.
Good. The rest will come when it comes, or it won't.
dialogue.conversations.fears.pressed.lea: Go on, then. Before either of us says more.
dialogue.conversations.fears.pressed.pus: No. NO. You were told, and you asked again. Get away from me.
That's what you are, then. Someone who takes. I won't forget it, %1$s.
You cracked it open because you wanted to see. I hope it was worth the look.
dialogue.conversations.fears.repaired.as: Now that I can do. Ask me about the fence, the harvest, anything with a floor to stand on.
Something easy. Aye. We'll build back up to the rest, in our own time.
Sensible, %1$s. Shallow water first. I'll tell you when I can swim again.
dialogue.conversations.fears.repaired.le: So I've found. Enough digging for one day. Come back and I'll still be here.
Right. Off you go, and thank you for the slower version.
Go on, %1$s. We're alright, you and I.
dialogue.conversations.fears.repaired.re: ...Then we'll get there. Slowly, and without anyone's hand on my back.
You'll keep to it. I believe you, which is the strange part.
That's all I ever wanted asked of me, %1$s. Just that.
dialogue.conversations.fears.resume.foll: I did the thing. Or started it. You'll want to hear.
Small progress on the old fear. Small counts.
Ask me about it. Go on. I've earned the asking.
dialogue.conversations.fears.resume.plan: That thing I told you about. It hasn't gone anywhere.
I've been thinking about what I said to you. Out loud didn't kill me.
It's still sat there, the fear. Politely. Waiting.
dialogue.conversations.fears.revisit/1: I've been chewing on what you asked me — about being afraid. It's lighter now that it's said.
dialogue.conversations.fears.revisit/2: That fear we talked about — I slept with the lantern out twice this week. Progress.
dialogue.conversations.fears.revisit/3: I keep coming back to what you asked. Naming a thing takes some of its teeth.
dialogue.conversations.fears.scarred.apo: ...Took you long enough. It doesn't undo it. But it's something.
You were wrong, aye. Saying so out loud costs you something, so — noted.
I'll not pretend it never happened, %1$s. But you can stand there.
dialogue.conversations.fears.scarred.giv: Good. That's the only thing left that helps.
Just so. Space. I'd rather that than another apology.
Right. Come back in a week and ask me about the fence, and we'll see where we are.
dialogue.conversations.fears.scarred/1: ...You. Right. Ask me about the weather, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.fears.scarred/2: I remember how the last one went. Let's not.
dialogue.conversations.fears.scarred/3: That door's got a bolt on it now. You put it there.
dialogue.conversations.fears.share.grate: You too? Huh. It's less heavy when two people carry it.
Strange comfort, that. Two cowards make one brave pair.
Then we watch each other's backs. That's how it's supposed to work anyway.
dialogue.conversations.fears.share.joke/: Then we'll hide under the same table when it storms. Bring bread.
Excellent. You bring the bread, I'll bring the trembling.
A matched set of cowards! The village should charge admission.
dialogue.conversations.fears.teen/1: That I'll end up exactly like everyone here and never find out what else I could've been.
